name: IC Interface USB — 3.3V, 5V, USB — SOIC
description: Surface-mount USB interface IC cluster in SOIC packaging supporting 3.3V and 5V operation.
selection_hints: Selecting a USB interface IC operating at 3.3V or 5V.
Layouts requiring SMD SOIC footprints such as SOIC-16_3.9x9.9mm_P1.27mm.
Designs referencing KiCad tier A components such as CH343G.
avoid_when: The PCB footprint requires a non-SOIC package.
Operating supply voltages other than 3.3V or 5V are needed.
Through-hole or non-SMD mounting is required.
